conference: may be one-off or short series
assessment is not mandatory unless explicitly authored
seminar: may require active participation, discussion, workshop or practical evidence
additional_course: does not automatically become a core-curriculum requirement

scheduling_rules: All required sessions must be feasible before registration is accepted.
Travel time is real and must fit around every session.
Presenter availability is required for every represented session.
Unavailable venue capability blocks the offering/session rather than fabricating an alternative.
Offering cancellation requires an explicit event and must not silently erase registration history.
selection_rules: NPC preference can use academic interests, branch interests and explicit enrichment preferences after feasibility.
Species and player proximity are excluded as selectors.
Capacity shortage produces waitlist rather than roster expansion.
